items.description: E2 UAS Aircraft including avionics, ground station
Engineering support for potential control law mods

notes: Quote for E2/Training/Engineering sent 10/31/2025 for $56k. Bruce Cogan (retired NASA) is coordinating a research proposal with Cal State Northridge for a VTOL UAV to support 2-way communication with city/building infrastructure. Initial inquiry indicates need for flight controller programming support for custom control law modifications. Urgent timeline implied (quote needed by Monday of initial contact).
